title: Gauntlet-like object with moving hieroglyphic symbols
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: it almost looked like a mirage type of effect and in that above that display screen were these hieroglyphic symbols that I started to see appear

plain: Randy Anderson told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2014, at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a US Navy research base in Indiana, he saw an object that looked like a gauntlet, an armored glove. He says it had a display screen with a shimmering, mirage-like effect, and above it symbols like hieroglyphs began to appear and move. If true, it would mean the military holds technology that is not human-made.
